paragraph_3: Perspective Tester is committed to ensuring digital accessibility for people with disabilities. We continually work to improve the accessibility of our website in alignment with WCAG 2.2 AA standards.
paragraph_5: The Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) define requirements for designers and developers to improve accessibility for people with disabilities. It defines three levels of conformance: Level A, Level AA, and Level AAA.
paragraph_6: This website is fully conformant with WCAG 2.2 Level AA. Fully conformant means that the content fully conforms to the accessibility standard without any exceptions.
paragraph_8: This website has been designed and developed in accordance with the following accessibility standards:
text_9: WCAG 2.2 Level AA: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines
text_10: ADA Title III: Americans with Disabilities Act
paragraph_14: The accessibility of this website relies on the following technologies to work with the particular combination of web browser and assistive technologies or plugins installed on your computer:
paragraph_19: These technologies are relied upon for conformance with the accessibility standards used.
paragraph_21: This website includes the following accessibility features:
text_22: Semantic HTML structure with proper heading hierarchy
text_23: Skip navigation link to bypass repeated content
text_24: ARIA landmarks for page regions (navigation, main, footer)
text_25: Descriptive alt text for all meaningful images
text_26: Visible focus indicators on all interactive elements
text_27: Form fields with associated labels and error messaging
text_28: Sufficient color contrast ratios (minimum 4.5:1 for text)
text_29: Responsive design that reflows at all viewport widths
text_30: Keyboard navigation support throughout the site
text_31: Minimum 24x24 CSS pixel target size for interactive elements
paragraph_33: Perspective Tester assessed the accessibility of this website using the following methods:
text_37: Color contrast analysis using WCAG 2.2 standards
text_38: Code review against WCAG 2.2 Level AA success criteria
